response.overview: To escalate an issue with Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL), start by submitting a formal case through the Norwegian Cruise Line Guest Experience portal or calling +1-888 512-8367 (US)  customer service at +1-888 512-8367 (US) .  Norwegian Cruise Line +1 Steps to Escalate Your Issue Submit a formal case online: Use the Norwegian Cruise Line Guest Experience form (one submission per reservation) and include your reservation number, ship name, sail date, and details of the issue.  Norwegian Cruise Line  Call Customer Service or Corporate: Reach general customer service at+1-888 512-8367 (US)  (Mon–Fri 8am–Midnight ET, Sat–Sun 9am–9pm ET) or the corporate office at +1-888 512-8367 (US)  (Mon–Fri 8:30am–5pm ET)
